top5.why: Core execution path; appears identical to audited Safe 1.3.0.
Signature verification; standard 1.3.0 logic with no deviation seen.
Enabled modules bypass signatures, so safety depends on module vetting.
Init is guarded by threshold check, front-running only affects undeployed proxies.
Calls a user-supplied callback after deployment; no fund impact.
Mints and LPs against a 1-2h TWAP with a 0.5% band, leaving small sandwich room.
Anyone can reset the TWAP snapshot once the minimum time has elapsed.
Gov or subgov can make arbitrary calls from the farming contract.
Queue and delay are skipped while admin_initialized is false.
Aggregates votes from external incentivizer contracts; trusted list only.
Admin-only upgrade with delegatecall; correctly gated.
Admin transfer is gated by onlyProxyAdmin.
Delegatecalls init data into the new implementation, reachable only by admin.
Sets implementation and admin atomically.
Standard delegatecall forwarding with fixed-slot storage.
Share minting prices token0 by manipulable slot0 spot price with no TWAP or deviation check, enabling flash-loan dilution of LPs (Gamma-style).
Pays out using manipulable live position amounts before burning shares, with a loose 'from' ownership check.
Swap with no price limit or slippage check and fee handling based on spot state.
Share valuation depends on slot0-derived amounts that can be moved within one tx.
Proportional liquidity rounding is computed on live manipulable position state.
Complex re-add and buyback accounting that depends on spot price at close, a possible pricing-error surface.
Window creation carves liquidity and tracks held ETH and tokens; accounting mismatch would drain the hook.
Linked-list segment bookkeeping vs pool liquidity; errors could desync.
Tax taken via delta on the unspecified side; rounding or sign errors are possible.
Refund arithmetic and solvency check on user-supplied msg.value and premium.
Standard factory; initializer call is made at deployment.
Calls a user-chosen callback; no fund impact.
Standard CREATE2 deploy; salt includes the initializer hash.
Proxy delegatecall forwarding, standard.
Non-deterministic variant of proxy creation.
Hybrid ERC20/721 mint and burn loops depend on whitelist state and balance rounding.
Values <= max NFT supply are treated as token ids, an ERC404 ambiguity.
Cross-chain mints hit the per-chain cap and could revert, locking bridged funds.
Whitelist flips skip NFT accounting; owner-only.
Overloaded approve for id versus amount.
Caller-chosen solver gets users' tokens and a callback; users are paid only their own atomic price.
No validation of price or amount; user-side risk only.
mulDivDown on atomicPrice and decimals rounds against the user.
View helper that mis-reports with duplicate users.
Advisory validity check only.

totalRewards is incremented by (balance - lastETHBalance) on every call but lastETHBalance is only updated when claimable>0, so repeated no-op calls inflate totalRewards and a holder can over-claim and drain others' ETH.
Uses stale totalRewards instead of the local total and divides by changing totalSupply.
Mints grow totalSupply and new tokens can claim historic rewards; receivedAirdrop is never set.
Fee forwarded via external call; transfer gating logic.
Transfers allowed for the owner regardless of unlock.
